Sofia Chen: Hi team — corpcard charge for overnight parking at SFO showed up as `SFO PARK` $42.50 but I don’t have an itemized receipt. Manager policy says >$25 needs itemized/parking stub. Any tips where to pull this?
Samir Patel: Do you have the transaction date + last4 of the card? sometimes the garage issues a paper ticket.
Sofia Chen: Date is 2026-03-18, last4 3456. I only have the card statement screenshot.
FinanceBot: FYI: For parking charges >$25 please attach either (1) vendor itemized receipt/garage voucher OR (2) photo of the parking ticket + manager approval. Missing docs may trigger a hold.
Priya Rao: @Sofia thanks — please upload the bank txn screenshot and add a short note with time and flight if it was travel-related. If the garage issued a QR/email, that works too.
Sofia Chen: Uploaded: https://files.redwood.com/receipts/parking_20260318_3456.jpg :receipt: — image shows entry/exit times but not a merchant name.
Jules Martin: Approved — I confirm this was work travel for customer visit on 3/18. :thumbsup:
Samir Patel: Merchant name mismatch is common — finance can reconcile using transaction id. Sofia, can you paste the bank txn id (or the corpcard portal tx id)? Example of where to find it: `Corpcard > Transactions > 2026-03-18 > view details`
Sofia Chen: Transaction ID: TXN-0b9f8a. I added it to the expense notes.
Marta Lopez: Thanks — I’ll queue this for reimbursement. Note for records: mark expense category `parking:airport` and put manager approver Jules Martin.
Priya Rao: Quick checklist for processing:
```
- receipt image attached
- bank screenshot attached
- manager approval present
- txn id included
```
All good here, will clear for payout in next batch.
Samir Patel: One small thing — corpcard batches sometimes show a different merchant (eg `SFO-GROUP`). If finance sees a mismatch they’ll reach out.
Sofia Chen: Great, thanks all — closing this thread once I see it in reimbursement portal.
FinanceBot: Expense submitted to Finance queue (ID 2026-EXP-784). Estimated reimbursement: next payroll cycle.
